targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, room_temp AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND event_type='snapshot' AND room_temp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, outside_temp AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND outside_temp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, dhw_temp AS `${t_cur}`, dhw_target AS `${t_tgt}` FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='dhw' AND event_type='snapshot' AND dhw_temp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, water_pressure_bar AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND water_pressure_bar IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF(burner_active=1,IF('${lang}'='en','ON','ACCESO'),IF('${lang}'='en','OFF','SPENTO')) AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND burner_active IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, modulation AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND modulation IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP() AS time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',UTC_TIMESTAMP()) - TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE event_type='snapshot' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, CASE program WHEN 'standby' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Standby','Standby') WHEN 'normal' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Normal','Normale') WHEN 'reduced' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Reduced','Ridotto') WHEN 'comfort' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Comfort','Comfort') WHEN 'eco' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Eco','Eco') WHEN 'holiday' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Holiday','Vacanza') WHEN 'holidayAtHome' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Holiday at home','Vacanza a casa') WHEN 'summerEco' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Summer eco','Eco estivo') WHEN 'fixed' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Fixed','Fisso') WHEN 'forcedLastFromSchedule' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Forced','Forzato') WHEN 'normalEnergySaving' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Normal (saving)','Normale (risparmio)') WHEN 'reducedEnergySaving' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Reduced (saving)','Ridotto (risparmio)') WHEN 'comfortEnergySaving' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Comfort (saving)','Comfort (risparmio)') ELSE program END AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND event_type='snapshot' AND program IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, CASE mode WHEN 'standby' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Standby','Standby') WHEN 'heating' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Heating','Riscaldamento') WHEN 'dhw' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','DHW only','Solo ACS') WHEN 'dhwAndHeating' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','DHW + Heating','ACS + Riscaldamento') WHEN 'heatingCooling' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Heating/Cooling','Risc. + Raffr.') WHEN 'forcedReduced' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Forced reduced','Ridotto forzato') WHEN 'forcedNormal' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Forced normal','Normale forzato') ELSE mode END AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND event_type='snapshot' AND mode IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, CASE mode WHEN 'eco' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Eco','Eco') WHEN 'comfort' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Comfort','Comfort') WHEN 'off' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Off','Spenta') WHEN 'efficient' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Efficient','Efficiente') WHEN 'efficientWithMinComfort' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Efficient+','Efficiente+') WHEN 'balanced' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Balanced','Bilanciata') ELSE mode END AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='dhw' AND event_type='snapshot' AND mode IN ('eco','comfort','off','efficient','efficientWithMinComfort','balanced') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP() AS time, MAX(burner_starts) - (SELECT burner_starts FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND burner_starts > 0 AND ts < CONVERT_TZ(DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'+00:00','${tz}')),'${tz}','+00:00') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND burner_starts > 0 AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}')) = DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'+00:00','${tz}'))

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP() AS time, MAX(burner_hours) - (SELECT burner_hours FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND burner_hours > 0 AND ts < CONVERT_TZ(DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'+00:00','${tz}')),'${tz}','+00:00') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND burner_hours > 0 AND DATE(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}')) = DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'+00:00','${tz}'))
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP() AS time, gas_heating_year_m3 + gas_dhw_year_m3 AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND gas_heating_year_m3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, status_code AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND status_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, wifi_rssi AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND wifi_rssi IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','Room','Ambiente') AS metric, room_temp AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND room_temp IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','Room target','Obiettivo ambiente') AS metric, target_temp AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND target_temp IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','Outside','Esterna') AS metric, outside_temp AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND outside_temp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','Circuit flow','Mandata circuito') AS metric, flow_temp AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND flow_temp IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','Boiler water','Acqua caldaia') AS metric, boiler_water_temp AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND boiler_water_temp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','DHW temperature','Temperatura ACS') AS metric, dhw_temp AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='dhw' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND dhw_temp IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','DHW target','Obiettivo ACS') AS metric, dhw_target AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='dhw' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND dhw_target IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','Comfort','Comfort') AS metric, hc_comfort_temp AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND hc_comfort_temp IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','Normal','Normale') AS metric, hc_normal_temp AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND hc_normal_temp IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','Reduced','Ridotta') AS metric, hc_reduced_temp AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND hc_reduced_temp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF(burner_active=1,IF('${lang}'='en','On','Acceso'),IF('${lang}'='en','Off','Spento')) AS `${t_burner}` FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND burner_active IS NOT NULL AND event_type IN ('snapshot','burner_on','burner_off') AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND) q UNION ALL SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(), NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','Modulation','Modulazione') AS metric, modulation AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND modulation IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',CONVERT_TZ(day,'${tz}','+00:00')) AS time, v - pv AS `${t_starts}` FROM (SELECT day, v, LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS pv, LAG(day) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS pday FROM (SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}')) AS day, MAX(burner_starts) AS v FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND burner_starts > 0 AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}'))) d) x WHERE pv IS NOT NULL AND v >= pv AND DATEDIFF(day,pday)=1 ORDER BY day

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',CONVERT_TZ(day,'${tz}','+00:00')) AS time, v - pv AS `${t_hours}` FROM (SELECT day, v, LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS pv, LAG(day) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS pday FROM (SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}')) AS day, MAX(burner_hours) AS v FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND burner_hours > 0 AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND GROUP BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}'))) d) x WHERE pv IS NOT NULL AND v >= pv AND DATEDIFF(day,pday)=1 ORDER BY day

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',CONVERT_TZ(day,'${tz}','+00:00')) AS time, CASE WHEN MONTH(day)<>MONTH(pday) THEN gh WHEN pr_gh IS NULL AND raw_gh > 0 THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(gh-p_gh,0) END AS `${t_gh}`, CASE WHEN MONTH(day)<>MONTH(pday) THEN gw WHEN pr_gw IS NULL AND raw_gw > 0 THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(gw-p_gw,0) END AS `${t_gw}` FROM (SELECT day, gh, raw_gh, LAG(gh) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS p_gh, LAG(raw_gh) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS pr_gh, gw, raw_gw, LAG(gw) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS p_gw, LAG(raw_gw) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS pr_gw, LAG(day) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS pday FROM (SELECT day, gh, raw_gh, gw, raw_gw FROM (SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}')) AS day, COALESCE(gas_heating_month_m3,0) AS gh, gas_heating_month_m3 AS raw_gh, COALESCE(gas_dhw_month_m3,0) AS gw, gas_dhw_month_m3 AS raw_gw, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}')) ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND burner_starts IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND - INTERVAL 2 DAY AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND) r WHERE rn=1) l) x WHERE pday IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(day,pday)=1 AND day >= DATE(CONVERT_TZ('1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND,'+00:00','${tz}')) ORDER BY day

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',CONVERT_TZ(CONCAT(ym,'-01'),'${tz}','+00:00')) AS time, `${t_gh}`, `${t_gw}` FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}'),'%Y-%m') AS ym, COALESCE(gas_heating_month_m3,0) AS `${t_gh}`, COALESCE(gas_dhw_month_m3,0) AS `${t_gw}`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}'),'%Y-%m') ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND burner_starts IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND - INTERVAL 31 DAY AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND) m WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY ym

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',CONVERT_TZ(CONCAT(ym,'-01'),'${tz}','+00:00')) AS time, `${t_hh}`, `${t_hw}` FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}'),'%Y-%m') AS ym, COALESCE(heat_heating_month_kwh,0) AS `${t_hh}`, COALESCE(heat_dhw_month_kwh,0) AS `${t_hw}`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}'),'%Y-%m') ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND burner_starts IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND - INTERVAL 31 DAY AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND) m WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY ym

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',CONVERT_TZ(CONCAT(ym,'-01'),'${tz}','+00:00')) AS time, `${t_eh}`, `${t_ew}` FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}'),'%Y-%m') AS ym, COALESCE(power_heating_month_kwh,0) AS `${t_eh}`, COALESCE(power_dhw_month_kwh,0) AS `${t_ew}`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(ts,'+00:00','${tz}'),'%Y-%m') ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND burner_starts IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND - INTERVAL 31 DAY AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND) m WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY ym

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP() AS time, 100 * (heat_heating_year_kwh + heat_dhw_year_kwh) / ((gas_heating_year_m3 + gas_dhw_year_m3) * ${kwh_m3}) AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND heat_heating_year_kwh IS NOT NULL AND gas_heating_year_m3 > 0 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP() AS time, gas_heating_year_m3 AS `${t_gh} (m³)`, gas_dhw_year_m3 AS `${t_gw} (m³)`, heat_heating_year_kwh + heat_dhw_year_kwh AS `${t_heat} (kWh)` FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND gas_heating_year_m3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, CASE program WHEN 'standby' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Standby','Standby') WHEN 'normal' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Normal','Normale') WHEN 'reduced' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Reduced','Ridotto') WHEN 'comfort' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Comfort','Comfort') WHEN 'eco' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Eco','Eco') WHEN 'holiday' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Holiday','Vacanza') WHEN 'holidayAtHome' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Holiday at home','Vacanza a casa') WHEN 'summerEco' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Summer eco','Eco estivo') WHEN 'fixed' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Fixed','Fisso') WHEN 'forcedLastFromSchedule' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Forced','Forzato') WHEN 'normalEnergySaving' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Normal (saving)','Normale (risparmio)') WHEN 'reducedEnergySaving' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Reduced (saving)','Ridotto (risparmio)') WHEN 'comfortEnergySaving' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Comfort (saving)','Comfort (risparmio)') ELSE program END AS `${t_hc_prog}`, CASE mode WHEN 'standby' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Standby','Standby') WHEN 'heating' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Heating','Riscaldamento') WHEN 'dhw' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','DHW only','Solo ACS') WHEN 'dhwAndHeating' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','DHW + Heating','ACS + Riscaldamento') WHEN 'heatingCooling' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Heating/Cooling','Risc. + Raffr.') WHEN 'forcedReduced' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Forced reduced','Ridotto forzato') WHEN 'forcedNormal' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Forced normal','Normale forzato') ELSE mode END AS `${t_hc_mode}` FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND event_type='snapshot' AND program IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND) q UNION ALL SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(), NULL, NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT * FROM (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, CASE mode WHEN 'eco' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Eco','Eco') WHEN 'comfort' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Comfort','Comfort') WHEN 'off' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Off','Spenta') WHEN 'efficient' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Efficient','Efficiente') WHEN 'efficientWithMinComfort' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Efficient+','Efficiente+') WHEN 'balanced' THEN IF('${lang}'='en','Balanced','Bilanciata') ELSE mode END AS `${t_dhw_mode}` FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='dhw' AND event_type='snapshot' AND mode IN ('eco','comfort','off','efficient','efficientWithMinComfort','balanced') AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND) q UNION ALL SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(), NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT * FROM (SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF(holiday_mode_active=1,IF('${lang}'='en','Active','Attiva'),'—') AS `${t_holiday}`, IF(extended_heating_active=1,IF('${lang}'='en','Active','Attivo'),'—') AS `${t_ext}` FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND event_type='snapshot' AND holiday_mode_active IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND) q UNION ALL SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(), NULL, NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','Pressure','Pressione') AS metric, water_pressure_bar AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND water_pressure_bar IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',ts) AS time, IF('${lang}'='en','RSSI','RSSI') AS metric, wifi_rssi AS value FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='boiler' AND event_type='snapshot' AND ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND AND wifi_rssi IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

WITH RECURSIVE s(x) AS (SELECT -15 UNION ALL SELECT x+1 FROM s WHERE x<25), p AS (SELECT hc_slope sl, hc_shift sh, COALESCE(hc_normal_temp, 20) rt FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND hc_slope IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), m AS (SELECT ROUND(b.outside_temp) o, ROUND(AVG(h.flow_temp),1) f, COUNT(*) n FROM viessmann_history h JOIN viessmann_history b ON b.accessory='boiler' AND b.event_type='snapshot' AND b.ts BETWEEN h.ts - INTERVAL 10 SECOND AND h.ts + INTERVAL 10 SECOND WHERE h.accessory='hc0' AND h.event_type='snapshot' AND h.mode='heating' AND b.burner_active=1 AND h.flow_temp > 0 AND h.ts BETWEEN '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochFrom() SECOND AND '1970-01-01' + INTERVAL $__unixEpochTo() SECOND GROUP BY ROUND(b.outside_temp)) SELECT s.x AS outdoor, LEAST(GREATEST(ROUND(p.rt + p.sh - p.sl*(s.x-p.rt)*(1.4347 + 0.021*(s.x-p.rt) + 0.0002479*POW(s.x-p.rt,2)),1), p.rt), 80) AS `${t_curve_calc}`, m.f AS `${t_curve_meas}` FROM s JOIN p LEFT JOIN m ON m.o = s.x ORDER BY s.x

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP() AS time, hc_slope AS `${t_slope}`, hc_shift AS `${t_shift}`, hc_normal_temp AS `${t_normal} (°C)`, hc_reduced_temp AS `${t_reduced} (°C)`, hc_comfort_temp AS `Comfort (°C)` FROM viessmann_history WHERE accessory='hc0' AND hc_slope IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
